# DataFortress.cloud

> Enterprise infrastructure consultancy run by Justin Güse. BaFin-compliant Kubernetes/OpenShift, petabyte-scale data engineering, and on-premise agentic AI for automotive, banking, and healthcare. Trusted by VW, BMW, Porsche, HPE, and Germany's largest cooperative banking network (120+ banks). Based in Bavaria, Germany. AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional.

## Core Services

- [Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps](https://datafortress.cloud/services/cloud-infrastructure-devops/): BaFin-compliant Kubernetes / OpenShift on-premise and hybrid, HashiCorp Vault, Istio service mesh, ArgoCD GitOps for German banking and regulated industries.
- [Data Engineering & Analytics](https://datafortress.cloud/services/data-engineering-analytics/): Trino, data lakes, data warehouses, ETL at petabyte scale. VW sampling-process pipeline, BMW worldwide backup (100PB+), Atruvia banking network DWH.
- [Agentic AI & ML Engineering](https://datafortress.cloud/services/agentic-ai-automation/): Production multi-agent LangGraph systems, custom LLM fine-tuning on Kubernetes GPUs, 100% on-premise deployments for clients with data residency constraints.

## Flagship Case Studies

- [Atruvia - DevOps Modernization & Banking Platform Engineering](https://datafortress.cloud/portfolio/atruvia-devops-modernization/): Multi-year DevOps engagement for Germany's 120+ cooperative banks. Jenkins → GitLab CI migration, Java Spring Boot microservices on OpenShift, Finanzamt (federal tax authority) integration layer, Istio service mesh with geographic locking, HashiCorp Vault.
- [Atruvia / Volksbank Data Warehouse](https://datafortress.cloud/portfolio/atruvia--volksbank-data-warehouse/): 45% cost reduction across 120+ German cooperative banks. Trino + object-storage migration.
- [VW / HPE Solution Architecture](https://datafortress.cloud/portfolio/vw-hpe-solution-architecture/): 64% faster time-to-market on VW sampling-process pipeline.
- [BMW Worldwide VM Backup](https://datafortress.cloud/portfolio/bmw-worldwide-backup-solution/): 100PB+ replicated across 60+ countries.
- [Google Research / TimesFM Open-Source Contribution](https://datafortress.cloud/portfolio/google-timesfm/): CI/CD + Python Poetry modernization merged upstream.

## In-House Products

- [AgentBureau](https://datafortress.cloud/products/agentbureau/): B2B AI agency arm - production multi-agent workflows, custom LLM fine-tuning, on-premise LLM deployments.
- [DocumentChat](https://datafortress.cloud/products/DocumentChat/): SaaS for chatting with documents and emails.
- [Myopiagraph](https://datafortress.cloud/products/myopiagraph/): Healthcare software for myopia management.
- [AI Investing Bots](https://datafortress.cloud/products/aiinvestingbots/): Algorithmic trading strategies.
- [NaviCareNow](https://datafortress.cloud/products/navicarenow/): Healthcare patient-navigation platform.
- [PsychDiary](https://datafortress.cloud/products/psychdiary/): AI mental-health journaling.
- [Tiledom](https://datafortress.cloud/products/tiledom/): Tile-based dashboard platform.
- [WiFiSenseBox](https://datafortress.cloud/products/wifisensebox/): IoT signal detection + environmental sensing.

## Engagement Model

- **Discovery Call** - free, 1 hour. If no fit, we refer someone better.
- **Hourly Consulting** - €190 / hr. Architecture reviews, audits, design sessions. 1-hour minimum, no retainer.
- **Fixed-Scope Engagement** - from €15K. 1–3 week deep-dive with written deliverable, or fractional architect retainer.
- **Free 1-hour Architecture Review** offer: "In 60 minutes I'll find €100K+ in compliance risk, cloud waste, or scaling headroom - or I walk."
